A really nice grill. I upgraded from a Weber Q grill on a rickety old cart (they have since improved those carts) and I have been really impressed. It heats up fast and hot, starts really easily and has been fun to use. 
The hook that you hang the propane tank on is a great idea, so the weight of the tank registers how much LP is left in the tank. However, it's extremely difficult and cumbersome to get a full tank inside the cabinet and hung on the hook. It's even more difficult to get a full tank off the hook and removed if you have to move the entire grill (as I did). Great idea but could be more user friendly. I do like that it's hidden inside the cabinet though.

Results.ReviewText: This is my first Weber grill and am very impressed with the quality and function of the grill. I like the warranty and availability of parts locally at numerous places. I noticed with just needing to unpack my grill outside on the porch where it was delivered because of the weight of a small grill. I found all the parts to be well made and heavy. When assembling the grill I brought all the parts into my screen porch and laid them out for assembly. The assembly was pretty easy by the very good instructions and the hardware separated into bags by assembly steps. The fuel tank gauge is nice and actually works. When grilling, I noticed the grill heated up faster and cooked better then my previous grill. I like the flavor bars versus the lava rock and on newer grills I have had used a pan under the grates to achieve an indirect infrared type cooking which didn’t work well. I love the size of the grill as it fits in the covered grilling area of my deck and the huge monster grills with 4 burners 5 feet long grill is seldom required. This grill has a nice compartment for the fuel tank with a door and working gauge. I can tell even the igniter electronic parts are much better then my previous grills.

Results.ReviewText: We have owned an E-210 for several years and love it!! When we saw the Spirit II's we were disappointed with the design. The tank hanging off the right side was a 'no-go' with our tinny porch plus we really like the door on the original E-210's. So, we bought a brand new one before they are gone forever and gave our original, which was gift and still in great condition, to our neighbor who's grill was falling apart. We love: the small footprint, the door that hides away all our accessories AND the tank, the drop down shelves (which we have to keep down when it's not in use), the tank gauge, the durability of the various components: grates, grill body, burner tubes, the accuracy of the thermometer in the lid, the design, the ease of assembly. It is also great to have a grill that allows you to cook in the dead of winter. It is the perfect grill or out tiny porch. We've had two of our townhome neighbors buy E-210's on our recommendation and they all love them! It's funny to see all four E-210's gilling away on the weekends!

ClientResponses.Response: Hello, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are sorry to hear about the disappointment with your cooking grates on your new Spirit E-210. We suggest preheating your grill for at least 15 minutes on high with the lid closed to and then brushing the cooking grates with a stainless steel brush. This will also help, so your food does not stick. For a more thorough cleaning of the grates, we suggest waiting for it to completely cool and remove the grates, then clean with a nonabrasive soap with warm water, tap dry with a paper towel. If you continue to have issues with this, please reach our support team, they are always happy to help!

46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
